correctness.rationale: Writing a,b,c,d,e,f for six skew entries and directly expanding 64 tensor coefficients yields b=0, 3a^2=0, a(c-d)=0, 2af+c^2-2cd=0, 3cf=0 over any field with 2≠0. Independently reconstructed eleven distinct nonzero coefficient polynomials, and independently enumerated all 3^6, 5^6 and 7^6 matrices, recovering (solution count, rank4)=(63,18),(145,20),(385,42). For char≠3 the field locus is {a=b=c=0} union {a=b=f=0,c=2d}. For char3 the c/d case split gives two A3 components and {b=0,c=d,af+c²=0}, an irreducible 3-dimensional quadric cylinder, pairwise intersection A2. Inclusion-exclusion gives N_q=q³+q²−q or 3q³−2q²; Pfaffian af-be+cd yields rank4 q(q−1) or q²(q−1). The two coboundary maps recover a,c,d,f while e is free, giving q-to-one fibers and counts q²+q−1 or 3q²−2q. Finite experiments corroborate a symbolic arbitrary-field proof, not replace it.
